purpose: calibrate the operating scale so trained clouds occupy the R2 band

init_gain_inertness.verdict: INERT — the init gain does not select the operating scale; the committed rule selects admissible (K, d, N) cells instead

rule.formula: log(median sqrt|K|*r) = intercept + c*log|K| + d*log(dim) + e*log(N), fitted separately per curvature sign. A cell is admissible when its predicted value lies inside the operating band.
